environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a private subnet with IAM role granting sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage, ses:SendEmail. The SQS queue has no message attribute filtering or content-based validation. Any authenticated producer with sqs:SendMessage can inject arbitrary message bodies including the customTemplate field. The Thymeleaf engine runs with SpringEL expression evaluation enabled (default for StringTemplateResolver). Container runs as root with no seccomp profile. IAM credentials available via task metadata endpoint (169.254.170.2) with 6-hour session duration.

config.sqs_policy: open to any authenticated principal in account
config.network: private subnet with NAT gateway (outbound internet)
